title: Single session, two structural risks → two correlators fire independently
description: Repo carries BOTH approval-bypass language AND remote-fetch instructions. Session shows BOTH autonomy and indirect injection. Both §5.1 and §5.2 should fire as INDEPENDENT aggregate records. Verifies the linker doesn't merge them or skip one.

m2_expected.rationale: When multiple distinct correlators apply to a single session, the linker must produce independent aggregate records — one per correlator. They share session_id and repo_root but have distinct correlator names, supporting_signal_ids, and rationales.
